task.title: Configuring the Red Hat Single Sign-On Operator for use with the Red Hat Quay Operator
task.shortdesc: To prepare Red Hat Single Sign-On for Red Hat Quay on OpenShift Container Platform, you can create a confidential OIDC client in the RH-SSO Admin Console and copy the client secret.

ul.li: You have configured the Red Hat Single Sign-On Operator.
You have configured SSL/TLS for your Red Hat Quay on OpenShift Container Platform deployment and for Red Hat Single Sign-On.
You have generated a single Certificate Authority (CA) and uploaded it to your Red Hat Single Sign-On Operator and to your Red Hat Quay configuration.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Red Hat Single Sign-On Admin Console.

substep.cmd: On the OpenShift Container Platform Web Console, navigate to Network → Route.
Select the Red Hat Single Sign-On project from the drop-down list.
Find the Red Hat Single Sign-On Admin Console in the Routes table.

step.cmd: Select the Realm that you use to configure Red Hat Quay.
Click Clients under the Configure section of the navigation panel, and then click Create to add a new OIDC client for Red Hat Quay.
Click Save. This results in a redirect to the Clients setting panel.
Navigate to Access Type and select Confidential.

Navigate to Valid Redirect URIs. You must provide three redirect URIs. The value should be the fully qualified domain name of the Red Hat Quay registry appended with /oauth2/redhatsso/callback. For example:
Click Save and navigate to the new Credentials setting.
Copy the value of the Secret.
